findings.title: Proceeds from Disposals has no plan data
findings.detail: Referenced by Net Cash Outflow from Investing Activities but evaluates to 0 in every version.
findings.prompt: Proceeds from Disposals (cf-disposals) has no data. Should it stay in the Net Cash Outflow from Investing Activities formula, and how should it be planned (driver, % of another line, or ML forecast)?

findings.title: Add Operating Expenses (excl. D&A) % of Revenue
findings.detail: Operating Expenses (excl. D&A) has no ratio KPI — common in EPM reporting packs.
findings.prompt: Add a new KPI "Operating Expenses (excl. D&A) % of Revenue" = opex-excl / rev * 100.

findings.title: Add Profit Before Tax % of Revenue
findings.detail: Profit Before Tax has no ratio KPI — common in EPM reporting packs.
findings.prompt: Add a new KPI "Profit Before Tax % of Revenue" = ebt / rev * 100.

findings.title: Gross Sales (list price, incl. Alliance) moved USD -170.46B vs Budget
